facts.title: Vue Bits - Animated UI Components For Vue
facts.description: An open source collection of high quality, animated, interactive & fully customizable Vue components for building stunning, memorable user interfaces.
facts.keywords: Vue, Vue tutorials, Vue tips, Vue best practices, Vue development, Vue guides, Vue articles, Vue ecosystem, JavaScript, frontend development, VueJS, UI Library, Component Library, Vue Components, Vue Animations

research.name: Vue Bits
research.note: Vue 3 counterpart of React Bits with 200+ animated backgrounds, text effects and components, many rendered with WebGL.
unverified: The components' source is public in the GitHub repository DavidHDev/vue-bits, linked from the site; that repository has not yet been researched in place of this site.
Only ColorBends was seen running on the homepage; the other effects were seen as names.
